checks.name: Pinned manifest and observed results match the saved workflow
Each actual evaluation passes the independent quality threshold
Wrong runtime direction is denied despite valid model evaluation
Correct winner passes the actual selection guard
A valid best-model receipt cannot release the inferior model
An omitted candidate cannot silently shrink the declared comparison
A copied result with a modified score is denied
Changed candidate configuration does not reuse approval
A stale candidate set cannot reuse selection approval
Held-out audit follows fixed winner and does not enter ranking evidence
Every referenced checkpoint, evaluation dataset and release marker has matching retained bytes
Local publication contains the approved exact winner and both decisions
Top-level outcome and committed final scope retain the same observed results
Three new training completions precede selection; held-out evaluation follows local publication
Independent NumPy report binds actual saved inputs, auditor sources and every numerical artifact
Native Lens reopens three distinct decision views with child processes denied
Self-contained investigation embeds the original captured journal and unchanged native bridge

boundaries: Saved evidence and native inspection are checked without child-process access.
NumPy report is source/input linked; this verifier does not rerun NumPy or JAX.
No human investigation advantage, global model optimum or remote deployment is established.
